name: Social Spark
tagline: Get a mission, talk it out together, and complete it as a team.

missions.title: Warm-up
missions.brief: Chat about the prompt. When your group is satisfied, everyone presses the button.
prompts: Each person shares the best thing that happened to them this week, then you all pick the one that made you smile most.
Tell the group about a small thing that always improves your day, and find one that two of you share.

missions.title: Deep Dive
missions.brief: Take your time with this one. Everyone presses the button when you have all had a turn.
prompts: Share a skill you want to learn this year and why. Then help each other choose a tiny first step.
Each person names a project they are proud of. Ask each other one question about it.

missions.title: Wild Card
missions.brief: Be creative. Every person must add at least one idea before you finish.
prompts: Invent a ridiculous startup together: a name, what it sells, and its slogan.
You are stuck on an island and can bring three items. Agree on the three and defend each one.
